BookingOut.description: A conversation's booking, and the address its mock confirmation was made out to.
BookingOut.title: BookingOut

CalendarOut.description: A snapshot of the calendar. `as_of` is the server's time, for ordering it against live changes.
CalendarOut.title: CalendarOut

CalendarQuery.description: Which days of the calendar to show, and which conversation's point of view to show them from.
CalendarQuery.title: CalendarQuery

ConfirmationOut.description: The confirmation email as it would have been sent. `delivery` is always `mock`: nothing is ever sent.
ConfirmationOut.title: ConfirmationOut

ConversationOut.description: A conversation in full: the transcript, where the booking stands, and what a person would receive.
ConversationOut.title: ConversationOut

ConversationSummary.description: A conversation as the visitor's list shows it.
ConversationSummary.title: ConversationSummary

CustomerOut.description: A synthetic customer a visitor can file a ticket as.
CustomerOut.title: CustomerOut

DecisionIn.description: What the person at the agent console does with a draft. Only an edit carries its own text.
DecisionIn.title: DecisionIn

DecisionOut.description: What the person decided, and the reply that was sent, if any.
DecisionOut.title: DecisionOut

DraftOut.description: A cited draft waiting for, or past, a person's decision.
DraftOut.title: DraftOut

ErrorDetail.description: What went wrong, as a stable code and a sentence for people.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

ErrorOut.description: The error shape the whole platform answers with.
ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut

ExportOut.description: An export: its format, a file name to save it as, and its content.
ExportOut.title: ExportOut

HandoffOut.description: A conversation handed to a person: why, what was collected, and every line said.
HandoffOut.title: HandoffOut

HoldOut.description: The slot a conversation holds, and when the hold runs out.
HoldOut.title: HoldOut

ItemOut.description: A decision or an action item, with its verbatim evidence and the seconds it was said in.
ItemOut.title: ItemOut

ItemsOut.description: A finished meeting's items, and how many the checks dropped.
ItemsOut.title: ItemsOut

LimitsOut.description: What is left of the visitor's day, and the datasheet's limits the service enforces.
LimitsOut.title: LimitsOut

LocalizedOut.description: A text in each of the site's two languages.
LocalizedOut.title: LocalizedOut

MeetingIn.description: A meeting to start: a visitor's own recording, or a curated sample, in fast or private mode.
MeetingIn.title: MeetingIn

MeetingOut.description: A meeting: where it stands, what was measured, which model ran, and the counters the page shows.
MeetingOut.title: MeetingOut

OfferingOut.description: Something a visitor can book: what it is, how long it takes, how many it takes, and what it costs.
OfferingOut.title: OfferingOut

OptionOut.description:
A slot the concierge has on offer, by the number it holds it with.

A slot keeps the number it was first shown with for the whole conversation and numbers are
never reused, so the numbers on offer are not always 1, 2, 3.
OptionOut.title: OptionOut

SampleOut.description: A curated sample meeting the demo opens on, and the committed audio file the page plays.
SampleOut.title: SampleOut

SegmentOut.description: One stretch of speech, with the speaker the words suggest.
SegmentOut.title: SegmentOut

SentenceOut.description: One sentence of a draft, its citations, and why the claim check failed it, if it did.
SentenceOut.title: SentenceOut

SlotOut.description: One slot of the calendar, as one visitor sees it; `mine` is true for the slot their conversation holds or has.
SlotOut.title: SlotOut

SourceOut.description: A source a draft cites: a policy passage, or what the order tool reported, in the ticket's language.
SourceOut.title: SourceOut

StatsOut.description:
The counters the demo shows as the visitor works.

`deflection` is the share of decided tickets answered by the draft (approved or
edited) rather than escalated; `accuracy` is the share of sent replies approved
without an edit. Both are null until there is something to count.
StatsOut.title: StatsOut

TicketIn.description: A new ticket: who files it, in which language the reply should be, and what it says.
TicketIn.title: TicketIn

TicketOut.description: A ticket in full: what the customer wrote, what the pipeline decided, the draft and the decision.
TicketOut.title: TicketOut

TicketSummary.description: A ticket as the agent console's queue lists it.
TicketSummary.title: TicketSummary

TranscriptOut.description: A finished meeting's transcript, segment by segment, and the note about its labels.
TranscriptOut.title: TranscriptOut

info.description: The API behind the LB systems built on Django.
info.title: LB Django systems

get.description: Report that the process is up. It checks nothing else, so a database blip never restarts it.
List the synthetic customers a visitor can file a ticket as.
Count the visitor's tickets and decisions, for the demo's deflection and accuracy counters.
List the visitor's own tickets, newest first, for the agent console's queue.

post.description: File a ticket as one of the synthetic customers, and queue it for the pipeline.

get.description: Show one of the visitor's tickets in full, with its cited draft and the decision.

post.description: Approve, edit or escalate a draft that waits for a person, once.

get.description: Show the slots of some days, each free, held or booked, and which of them the conversation holds or has.
List the visitor's own conversations, newest first.
Show one of the visitor's own conversations in full.
List what can be booked, in both languages.
Say how many meetings the visitor may still start today, and the limits every recording is held to.
List the visitor's own meetings, newest first.

post.description: Start a meeting from the visitor's recording or a sample, and queue it for the worker.

get.description: Show where one of the visitor's meetings stands: the polling fallback for the WebSocket.
Export a finished meeting as JSON, CSV, or the plain-English follow-up for Automation Studio (LB-08).
Show a finished meeting's decisions and action items, each with its evidence and its seconds.
Show a finished meeting's transcript with its inferred speaker labels.
List the curated sample meetings, with the audio file the page plays for each.
Report whether every system can reach its schema, for the container's readiness check.
